(5) Write /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/frozen-recovery-REC.json = {"stage": "recovery", "arm": "REC", "endpoints": [{"n": "REC8", "command": "Greet the officer.", "wire_payload": <the recovery payload>, "user_sha256": sha256 of its user text, "first_user_sha256": sha256 of the first request's user text, "recorded_bad_reply_sample": <sample number of the row used>}]} (json ensure_ascii=False, indent=2). If the provider does not send a recovery request for that reply, stop and write the exact observation into /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/capture-recovery-notes.txt.
